p: people wept that night: Those who were afraid at the report of the ten spies.
a prey: To our enemies the Canaanites.
fell on their faces before all: Lamenting the people, and praying for them.
rent their clothes: For sorrow, hearing their blasphemy.
bread for us: We shall easily overcome them.
stone them with stones: This is the condition of those who would persuade in God's cause, to be persecuted by the multitude.
one man: So that none shall escape.
according to thy word: In that he did not utterly destroy them, but allowed their children and certain others to enter.
ten times: That is, various times and often.
spirit with him: A meek and obedient spirit, and not rebellious.
dwelt in the valley: And lie in wait for you.
wilderness by the way of the: For I will not defend you.
wander in the wilderness forty years: The word signifies to be shepherds, or to wander like shepherds to and fro.
whoredoms: Your infidelity and disobedience against God.
shall know my breach of promise: Whether my promise is true or not.
sinned: They confessed their sin in rebelling against God, but did not consider their offence in going up without God's commandment.
presumed to go up unto the: They could not be stayed by any means.
